blocks.title: Craft Anything in the activity panel
blocks.description: Pick a target, study how it is put together, then rebuild it step by step — the upstream Craft Anything workbench running inside Astravia.

showcase.user_prompt: Rebuild the pricing page at this URL.
showcase.assistant_reply: Craft Anything is open. Let us settle the scope first: one page or the whole flow, and how close the copy has to be before I start clicking.

items.title: Study before building
items.description: The work starts from what the original actually does — layout, states, interactions — instead of a guess made from a screenshot.

items.title: A plan the agent can follow
items.description: The reconstruction is broken into steps with visible progress, so a rebuild can be paused, reviewed and resumed instead of run as one long shot.

items.title: Every step leaves a picture
items.description: A capture tool records what the workbench is showing at each stage, which is what makes a rebuild reviewable at all.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 3 MB of editor files arrive on first open and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the Craft Anything tab
items.description: The preparation screen is the hub fetching its payload.

items.title: Name the target and the scope
items.description: A URL, an app, or a file in the workspace — with the boundary of what has to be reproduced.

items.title: Work through the steps, checking each one
items.description: Progress is visible in the workbench; the agent checks each stage with a capture rather than assuming.

blocks.content: Rebuilding someone else's product raises questions a plugin cannot answer: only reproduce what you have the right to. The plugin runs the pinned release and adds no study features of its own.
